title: Huawei unveils 2027 Ascend 960 AI-chip roadmap
summary: Huawei said it will launch Ascend 960DT in Q1 2027 and 960PR in Q3 2027, with its UnifiedBus interconnect to link many chips into larger systems.
reason: Chinese domestic compute roadmap; erodes US chip dominance slightly; roadmap only.

title: Pew: more people expect AI to cut jobs than create them in 34 of 37 countries
summary: A Pew Research Center global survey found majorities or pluralities expect AI to eliminate more jobs than it creates in 34 of 37 countries; the US share rose seven points in two years.
reason: Broad public pessimism about AI's labour effects; expectations, not measured losses.

title: 'Stop the AI Race' marchers target OpenAI and Anthropic during Dreamforce
summary: About two dozen protesters rallied outside OpenAI and Anthropic offices in San Francisco and marched to City Hall demanding a slowdown of AI development.
